title: Drop skill_source = "plugin" so the lore skill is repo-local while opum-lore is off (DEC-238 a1)
description: DEC-238 (a1), relayed by team-lead 2026-10-25: while opum-lore is off in a checkout, workers get the lore skill from a repo-local generated SKILL.md. Measured here: .lore/config.toml on origin/dev sets [agents] skill_source = "plugin" (line 54); the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json sets "opum-lore@opum": false; `lore agents --check` reports absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum, exit 0. So the checkout has NO lore skill at runtime. The edit touches this repository own governing files (tier 2), so it is our decision, not instructed. FILED ONLY: start nothing until the opum-doc plan schedules it. Do not touch settings.local.json. Return to skill_source = "plugin" only once the plugin is measured enabled in this checkout.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore agents has been run and .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists, generated by lore
lore agents --check exits 0 with no absent-plugin-sourced line
bun run lore check exits 0 and bun test passes
